title: Service Accounts and Repair Orders — Posted Labor Rates and Tier Discount Schedule
content:
Posted customer-pay labor rates of the group's stores and the tier discounts on labor and parts that apply to **Service Accounts and Repair Orders**.

## Posted labor rate by store (USD per flat-rate hour)
The posted rate is the rate of the store that writes the repair order. Every tier uses the same posted rates.

| Store code | Posted rate |
|---|---|
| KTD | 179.00 |
| KHB | 172.00 |
| KFS | 168.00 |
| KCF | 165.00 |
| KHR | 149.00 |
| KCV | 158.00 |

## Tier discounts
| Tier | Labor discount | Parts discount on list price | Largest labor discount on one repair order (USD) | Tires excluded from the parts discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service Guest Account | 0% | 0% | 0.00 | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 5% | 0% | 50.00 | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | 10% | 5% | 100.00 | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 15% | 10% | 200.00 | Yes |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 12% | 15% | 1000.00 | Yes |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 15% | 18% | 1000.00 | Yes |

## Reading the schedule
- A 0% entry means the tier receives no discount of that kind.
- Because tires are excluded on every tier, a tire is priced at its list price on every account.
- The labor discount is a share of the labor list amount; the dollar figure in the fourth column is the most that share may come to on one repair order.
